# fflate 0.8.2

Unmodified UMD distribution of [fflate](https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate), version 0.8.2, from the published npm package. MIT license; see LICENSE.

Bundled locally because the production deploy hook updates backend/package-lock.json and cannot pull a commit that modifies that lockfile. Only the synchronous ZIP APIs are used. Keep the source and license together when updating.
